title: THE FRONTIER WEEK · title page
venue: the Newport paper · a western week the editor cut · Box 3
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. Every strip he'll be asked his name. Every strip he'll say the town's.

panels.composition: The plank sign hung across the top with the title burned into it. Below, the ridge in 1871 from the trading post's step: the single stump on the skyline with nothing on it yet, the town's one street below as a boardwalk and a shingle wall, dust drawn as stipple, a mule's tracks leading in.
